cohort: Three pregnant women who underwent cesarean section and subsequently experienced intractable postpartum hemorrhage due to uterine atony.
finding: While effective in controlling intractable postpartum hemorrhage, combined modified B-Lynch suture and vascular ligation carries risks of serious complications such as uterine necrosis, infection, and subinvolution.
mod_finding: The study focuses on complications arising from a specific surgical technique used to manage postpartum hemorrhage after cesarean sections.
who: Mothers who experience intractable postpartum hemorrhage
